Subject: StDenis RFP: PHI handling questionnaire & BAA template

Hi Markus,

Attached is our standard healthcare security questionnaire focused on PHI handling along with our BAA template. We're evaluating vendors for a pilot that will process limited PHI for scheduling and patient intake forms. Key asks:

- Confirmation of US-only data residency for PHI
- KMS/HSM details for tenant keying
- Audit log retention and access evidence
- Data deletion processes and certification
- Any subcontractors with access to PHI (list and flow-downs)

Can you confirm whether Redwood can operate in a hosted mode for PHI or if Private/Dedicated is required? We'd like initial responses by COB Jul 22. Also attaching our redline-ready BAA; our legal team will track changes there.

- stdenis-phi-questionnaire.xlsx (XLSX)

Hi Elena,

Thanks for sending — we've received the questionnaire and the BAA template. We'll assemble a consolidated response. Quick summary:

- Redwood can support US-only processing regions and offers a Private deployment for full customer-managed VPCs.
- We support customer-managed KMS integration (AWS KMS/HSM) and can provide per-tenant envelope encryption.
- Audit logs (API + admin actions) are retained by default for 13 months; extended retention is available as an add-on.

I'll loop in Monica (Security) and Kimberly (Legal) to provide technical/contract details. Expect a full packet by EOD Jul 22; if you need earlier files, let us know.

Subject: Re: StDenis RFP: PHI handling questionnaire & BAA template — technical clarifications

Hi Elena,

A few technical clarifications and evidence pointers below:

1) Encryption
- Data in transit: TLS 1.2+ (mutual TLS for private deployments available)
- Data at rest: AES-256-GCM for model artifact/storage; envelope encryption with customer KMS supported
- KMS: We support AWS KMS (CMKs), bring-your-own key (BYOK) flows; HSM-backed keys for Dedicated/Private

2) Audit logs & access
- API request logs, admin console access, and model invocation logs are captured. Default retention: 13 months; can be extended to meet your retention policy.
- Logs are tamper-evident and exportable to your SIEM (S3, CloudWatch, or secure FTP).

3) Subprocessors
- We limit subprocessors with access to PHI; current list: managed GPU providers, regional cloud storage (US regions only for PHI by config). We will provide an up-to-date subprocessor list and execute flow-downs in the BAA.

4) Data deletion
- We support customer-initiated deletion with verification certs for Dedicated/Private. For Hosted, deletion follows our purge workflow and we can provide deletion attestations on request.

5) Compliance
- SOC 2 Type II report available (summary attached). HITRUST assessment underway; expected completion Q4 2025.

Attachments:
- kms-architecture.pdf (PDF)
- soc2-type2-summary.pdf (PDF)

Let me know if you want a quick technical call to walk the team through the data flows.

Thanks,

Monica Patel
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: StDenis RFP: follow-ups and BAA redline

Markus/Monica,

Thank you — the technical detail is helpful. Our legal team attached a redline of the BAA with specific concerns around:

- Subprocessor flow-downs (we require 3rd-party audits or contractual flow-downs)
- Data deletion timing (we need explicit maximum deletion windows after contract termination)
- Right to audit (we request reasonable audit windows and scope)

Also, for the pilot we'd prefer Redwood Private if that reduces shared-infrastructure risk. Can you confirm delivery lead time and a one-time onboarding fee for Private?

Attached:
- stdenis_baa_redline.docx (DOCX)

Regards,

Elena Ruiz
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@stdenis-health.org>
Cc: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-07-21T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: StDenis BAA redline — proposed language

Hi Elena,

Appreciate the redline. Attached is a draft response with proposed BAA edits addressing:

- Subprocessor obligations (we will provide current SOC 2 reports and commit to flow-downs; any additional audit requests can be scoped as a one-off with confidentiality protections)
- Deletion windows: proposing 90 days for Hosted, 30 days for Private/Dedicated with certification of deletion
- Right to audit: we propose on-site or remote audits with reasonable notice and cost allocation for any third-party audits

We're open to negotiating tighter windows but need to balance operational constraints. For Private deployment:
- Typical lead time: 6–8 weeks for a standard VPC deployment (depends on network approvals)
- One-time onboarding fee: to be included in the quote; will provide details via procurement.

Attachments:
- baa-redline-response-20250721.docx (DOCX)

I'll follow up with a proposed SOW and PO instructions once procurement is ready.

Best,

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts
